text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 158 March 17, 1973
EXTENDING UNTIL APRIL 15, 1973 THE DEADLINE FOR FILING OF APPLICATION FOR
AMNESTY UNDER PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 95 DATED JANUARY 11, 1973 AND
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 124, DATED FEBRUARY 2, 1973
WHEREAS, Presidential Decree No. 95, dated January 11, 1973 and Presidential Decree No. 124, dated
February 2, 1973 were promulgated by me as a measure of restoring peace and order in the country, and
unifying the Filipino Nation;
WHEREAS, the period within which to file applications for amnesty in accordance with the said Presidential
Decrees expired on February 28, 1973 and March 15, 1973, respectively;
WHEREAS, in view of the limited period within which to disseminate fully the details of the said Presidential
Decrees, especially in the remote areas of the country, many of those who could have availed themselves of
the benefits of amnesty therein proclaimed were unable to file their applications on time;
WHEREAS, reports from field units of the Armed Forces of the Philippines and feelers from leaders of
misguided elements revealed that many have signified their intention to surrender to the military authorities
and avail of the amnesty in accordance with said Presidential Decrees;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, pursuant to Proclamations No. 1081, dated September
21, 1972 and No. 1104, dated January 17, 1973, and in my capacity as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed
Forces of the Philippines, do hereby order and decree that the deadline for the filing of application for amnesty
under Presidential Decree No. 95, dated January 11, 1973 and Presidential Decree No. 124, dated February 2,
1973 is extended until April 15, 1973.
I do further order and decree that the rules and regulations promulgated by the Secretary of Justice and the
Secretary of National Defense, as well as all other administrative orders, rules and regulations in the
implementation of the aforesaid Presidential Decrees, shall continue to be in full force and effect except as
they may be inconsistent herewith and therefore amended and modified accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
